items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And he used to get all those youngsters like me... would play.

ctx.x: What about Bud Russell? Bud Russell?

Oh, Bud Russel. Russel. Yeah, he, you see, I got to spell it wrong, isn't it? Bud Russel. But he had a band a long time. You remember a boy, don't you, Bud Russel? Bass player. Oh, he had different bands, you know. And he used to get all those youngsters like me, George McCullum. Little young fellas, you know, would play. And we kept him up. He always get a good band. He kept up to, he couldn't play no more, you know. Went to work, things got data on there. He'd get plenty of work through it. How long has he been…
